docs: Hanko, refract a tokenized share into its spectrum.
`initialize_vault` opens a market; `deposit` mints SHIELD + CORE + EDGE
against a deposited share; `recombine` burns the triplet to reclaim it.
The conservation invariant (three tokens ≡ one share) is enforced here.

instructions.name: init_pool
docs: Open a constant-product pool between two mints (a tranche and its
underlying) and seed it with the opening liquidity.

instructions.name: set_feed
docs: Configure the Pyth feed for a vault (authority only).

instructions.name: settle_with_oracle
docs: Permissionlessly settle an oracle-configured vault from a fresh Pyth price.

accounts.name: price_update
docs: matches this vault's, and the price is fresh.

instructions.name: swap
docs: Trade along the pool's x*y=k curve: buy a single tranche with the
underlying, or sell a tranche back for it.

instructions.name: withdraw_liquidity
docs: Withdraw seeded pool liquidity back to the pool's liquidity provider.

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: BadStrikes
errors.msg: Cap price must be strictly greater than floor price

errors.name: InvalidPrice
errors.msg: Settlement price must be greater than zero

errors.name: EmptyReserves
errors.msg: Pool reserves must be greater than zero

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Output is below the minimum requested

errors.name: BadOracle
errors.msg: Price update account is not a valid Pyth receiver account

errors.name: WrongFeed
errors.msg: Price update is for a different feed than this vault

types.name: OracleFeed
docs: Per-vault Pyth feed configuration. Additive: a vault without one keeps the
interim authority `settle`; one with a feed can be settled permissionlessly
from a signed Pyth price via `settle_with_oracle`.

types.name: Pool
docs: A constant-product pool between mint_a (a tranche) and mint_b (the
underlying). Reserves are read from the pool's own token accounts, so a
swap needs no stored balances. Protocol-owned liquidity for the demo.

fields.name: authority
docs: The liquidity provider who seeded the pool and may withdraw it.

types.name: Vault
docs: A Hanko vault refracts one underlying share into three tranche tokens.
Invariant: for every unit of `underlying_mint` held in the vault's token
account, exactly one unit of each of SHIELD, CORE and EDGE is in
circulation. `deposit` mints the triplet; `recombine` burns it back.
`floor_price` (L) and `cap_price` (U) define the payoff split at maturity
and are quoted in the oracle's price units. They are unused until `settle`.

constants.name: FEED_SEED
docs: Per-vault Pyth feed config PDA seed.

constants.name: POOL_SEED
docs: Constant-product pool between two mints (a tranche and the underlying).

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: PDA seeds. One vault per underlying mint; three tranche mints per vault.
